title: Duet Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Down a charming footpath, Duet is a cozy, but spacious cottage that is just a short stroll from the Odessa and Pensacola beach pavilions and the Westside Pool.
description_expanded: Description75 Grayton Street2 QUEENSWelcome to Duet | A Seaside, Florida Cottage RetreatTucked along a quiet footpath in the heart of Seaside, Florida, Duet is a charming two-bedroom, two-bath cottage offering the perfect blend of privacy, walkability, and coastal comfort. Located just three blocks from Seaside’s town center and eight homes from the beach, this inviting retreat places you within easy reach of the Gulf while maintaining a peaceful, residential feel—ideal for couples, families, or friends traveling together.Screened Porch Living & Bright Coastal InteriorsBegin your mornings and wind down your evenings on the cozy screened-in front porch, thoughtfully furnished with seating for relaxing, reading, or enjoying the gentle coastal breeze. Step inside to a light-filled open living and dining area, where large windows welcome in Seaside’s sunshine. The space features a flat-screen TV and a dining table for six, creating a comfortable setting for shared meals, game nights, and time together after a day at the beach.Well-Appointed Kitchen & Main-Level Primary SuiteThe first-floor kitchen is designed for easy vacation living, complete with bar seating that invites conversation while meals are prepared. Just off the main living space, the downstairs primary bedroom offers a queen bed, flat-screen TV, ample storage, and a recently renovated private bathroom, providing a relaxing and convenient retreat at the end of the day.Private Guest Suite UpstairsUpstairs, the second queen bedroom serves as a peaceful guest suite, featuring its own newly renovated private bathroom and flat-screen TV. This thoughtful layout ensures comfort and privacy for everyone in your group.Outdoor Amenities & Private Beach AccessStep outside to enjoy the outdoor deck with a charcoal grill, perfect for casual dinners after the beach. Additional conveniences include a stackable washer and dryer and an outdoor shower, ideal for rinsing off sandy feet. Guests also enjoy private access to Odessa Pavilion, just steps away—making it effortless to spend your days on Seaside’s iconic white-sand beaches and emerald Gulf waters.Walk to Town, Beach & Seaside ExperiencesFrom boutique shopping and local dining to live music and events in the town center, everything Seaside is known for is just a short walk away. Whether you’re soaking up the sun, exploring the community, or enjoying quiet moments at home, Duet offers an inviting and centrally located base for your Seaside, Florida vacation.Sat to Sat 7-night minimum Spring Break and Summer; 5-night minimum Spring; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. No children ages 13 -19 during Spring Break season.FEATURES866 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space176 yards or an easy 3-minute walk to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Odessa Pavilion, home to the largest stretch of private beaches on 30ALocated directly across from the West Side family poolAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote included with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued per one-bedroom cottage. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002085
